keywords.indexterm: driving electric vehicle starting the vehicle

li.p: Holding the smart key or registered digital key 2, sit in the driver’s seat.
Fasten the seat belt before starting the vehicle.
Make sure to engage the parking brake.
Check the position of the accelerator pedal and the brake pedal and the clearance with your right foot.
Make sure to depress and hold the brake pedal.
While depressing the brake pedal, shift to P (Park).
Depress and hold the brake pedal while pressing the EV button.
When the indicator is ON, you can drive the vehicle. When the indicator is OFF, you cannot drive the vehicle. Restart the vehicle.
Depress and hold the brake pedal and shift to the desired position
Release the parking brake and slowly release the brake pedal. Check if the vehicle slowly moves forward, then depress the accelerator pedal.
